model: QNA2..D indoor air quality multi-sensor (BACnet IP / MS/TP)
equipment_type: Indoor air quality sensor (temperature, humidity, CO2, TVOC, PM2.5, light, noise)
applies_to: Siemens QNA2..D indoor air quality multi-sensors with BACnet.
summary: The QNA2..D is a room multi-sensor that reports nine read-only Analog Inputs: temperature in °C and °F, humidity, CO2, TVOC, PM2.5, light, noise and a 0-100 air quality score. It runs on BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP.
notes: Object list from the BACnet PICS topic of the data sheet (edition 2025-06-18).
The air quality score (AI 7) is a Siemens proprietary index with no BACnet unit.
Temperature is given twice, in °C (AI 0) and °F (AI 8).
There is no access column; all objects are inputs and listed as read-only.

source.title: QNA2..D Indoor air quality multi-sensor Data Sheet

integration.summary: Poll or read the Analog Inputs you need; pick AI 0 or AI 8 depending on the unit system. CO2, TVOC and PM2.5 are the usual ventilation inputs.
setup: BACnet IP or MS/TP master at 9600-115200 baud.
Max Master and Max Info Frames are supported on the device object.
